query: (sum by (namespace, pod, container) (increase(container_oom_events_total{container!="", container!="POD"}[7d])) > 0) or (sum by (namespace, pod, container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[7d])) and on (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{reason="OOMKilled"} == 1))
why: How many times a container was OOM-killed in 7 days (increase of cAdvisor container_oom_events_total). "Last termination reason" shows only one event; this is the frequency
